# `bit_or`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
bit_or(expr)
```

Returns the bitwise OR of all non-null input values, or null if none.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- bit_or, example 1
> SELECT bit_or(col) FROM VALUES (3), (5) AS tab(col);
7
```
